title: Desktop CNC router
description: Frame from 2040 and 2080 aluminium extrusions, MGN12 linear rails and T8 lead screws on all axes, NEMA 23 steppers and a trim router spindle. Work area 300 × 300 × 80 mm.

title: Organizer box
description: A 3D printed organizer with a hinged lid and finger scoops. The grid of compartments is a parameter: change it and the whole box follows, including dividers and hinge.

title: Quadruped robot
description: Four legs with three joints each, driven by brushless motors with a 6:1 planetary gear. The trot comes from inverse kinematics in the animation script; the floor runs underneath.

title: Wall shelf
description: An oak board on two steel brackets with a load of 50 kg spread over the top. CalculiX computes stress and deflection; the colors show where the shelf carries the load.

title: Raspberry Pi 5 case
description: Case with a vented lid, heat-set inserts and screws.
